title: Macro Mondrian Conformal Risk Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.35035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal Risk Control (CRC) extends conformal prediction beyond the coverage setting to the control of general monotone loss functions, in a distribution-free and modelagnostic fashion. This makes it well-suited to problems with high-dimensional targets, such as the semantic segmentation task addressed in this work. However, CRC guarantees only marginal control, meaning that the risk is controlled on average over the data distribution. Under imbalanced distributions, the risk on inputs that contain rare objects may therefore remain uncontrolled, even when the marginal guarantee holds. We propose a new method that controls the risk on average over user-defined groups of the domain, drawing on Mondrian conformal prediction and macro-coverage algorithms. translated_title: 宏观蒙德里安保形风险控制
translated_abstract: 保形风险控制将保形预测从覆盖设置扩展到对一般单调损失函数的控制，以无分布且与模型无关的方式进行。这使其非常适合具有高维目标的问题，例如本文所研究的语义分割任务。然而，保形风险控制仅提供边际保证，即风险仅在数据分布上平均受控。在不平衡分布下，即使边际保证成立，包含稀有对象的输入的风险可能仍然不受控制。我们提出了一种新方法，借鉴蒙德里安保形预测和宏观覆盖算法，在用户定义的域分组上对风险进行平均控制。该方法依赖于一个分类体系，即为每个数据点分配分组的函数，并根据每个点所属分组的概率，通过相应系数对其风险进行重加权，从而使各分组的风险得到有效控制。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合蒙德里安保形预测与宏观覆盖算法的新方法，通过对用户定义的分组进行平均风险控制，解决了标准保形风险控制在不平衡分布下对稀有对象风险失控的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method combining Mondrian conformal prediction and macro-coverage algorithms to control risk on average over user-defined groups, addressing the failure of standard Conformal Risk Control to bound risk on rare objects under imbalanced distributions.
